checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Eyebrows, eyes, skin tone and expression resemble her, though her curly hair is hidden and the face looks a bit broad and softened.

must.item: Face fits in helmet without seams or doubled features
must.why: It blends well with the visor, with no visible seams or doubled features. It is slightly smooth and bright.
The background and suit are unchanged.

must.item: Retro look and vertical composition retained
must.why: The poster border, grain and tall shape are unchanged.

faults.what: The face is slightly over-smoothed and brighter than the surrounding scene, and her curly dark hair is not carried over, so likeness is only moderate.

summary: The face swap is clean and the poster is intact, with only a slightly smooth, bright face and a moderate likeness.
